questions.prompt: What does the new decision give museums a chance to do?
options: Borrow the object for a short trip abroad.
Find another axe at the same farm.
Buy the object and keep it for public display.
Move the object back to the place of discovery.
questions.explanationZh: 暂时限制出口是为了给合适机构筹款购买、留在国内展示的时间；不是出借、寻找另一件或送回发现地。

questions.prompt: How was the axe head discovered?
options: During work on a farm in 1974.
During work in a museum in 2026.
questions.explanationZh: s3说明1974年冬天在农活中发现；2026年是出口决定的年份。

questions.prompt: What is still uncertain in the announcement?
options: Whether the object is made of stone.
Whether it was found in North Yorkshire.
Whether it can help people study the past.
Whether a museum will manage to buy it.
questions.explanationZh: s7–8给出争取购买的机会，s10明确未宣布已购得，因此最终能否买下仍未知。
